contractReference.note: Contract contents are not byte-read through the recording connector; field inventory and canonical order are recorded from the admitted PR record, which is member-authored and merged. The six-field set and order are treated as REPORTED-from-record; the blob identity is OBSERVED.

validator.abstentionSemantics: Any structural break in binding, capture, readout, witness, ordering, or cross-reference yields UNVERIFIED with a named failure code. There is no partial credit.

claimSurfaces: No execution has run; no bound route exists; no executional receipt has been emitted. Every estate organ remains MODELED or NO_ORGAN.
This wave ships a structural checker only; it inspects a witness bundle's shape against the contract's six fields and validates nothing about any deployed system.

The checker does not and cannot prove a route exists, a DSSE envelope verifies, or timestamps are truthful; it only enforces that a claimed witness bundle is internally complete and ordered before any deeper verification lane consumes it.
A passing structural check is a precondition for evaluation, not evidence of executional satisfaction.
If the checker and an executor disagree, that is evidence of route or record drift, never of success.

relationToLane.rule: Claim graduation happens only by a new wave receipt citing a witness record that passes every contract field; this checker is one input to that evaluation, never the graduation itself.
